blocks.text: Want to convert your Cool Bar from cooler/coffee table into a party-perfect cocktail table? Simply lift the lid and twist the locking ring. Voila! Cold drinks, Cool Bar, instant party! And to keep the party going, the Cool Bar's 7. 5 gallon cooler can keep drinks chilled for more than 12 hours! The top rises smoothly from 22. 5 inches to 32. 5 inches in overall height and locks into place to prevent it from falling when topped with party provisions. And when you are done, simply remove the built in drainage plug for easy cleanup. When you’re ready to change the mood, the top of the cooler can be twists back down into a sleek cocktail or coffee table. As friends gather around the Cool Bar, you can feel confident that this contemporary piece adds just the right element of class and style. So whether you want a stylish accent table or a functional party accessory, you can have it all -- with the Cool Bar from Keter. While the compact design will easily fit into the layout of even the smallest deck, patio, or yard space, if you have larger outdoor living areas, you can place one on either side of each sofa, love seat, or chair to use as end tables. It would then be easy enough for you to pull out all of the Cool Bars and stock them with beverages and ice whenever you decide to host a large gathering. Features & Benefits: Dimensions: 19. 5D x 33. 2H in. Lid extends upwards into table 10 in. above rim Sturdy engineered legs for optimal support 7. 5 Gallon drink storage capacity to handle up to 40 12 oz. cans with ice Built in drainage plug makes cleanup a breeze Beverage cooler keeps drinks ice cold for up to 12 hours Sleek contemporary design blends with a wide variety of indoor or outdoor patio decor Table top locks in place for easy access to drinks Weather-resistant - can be left outside without worrying about rust, decay and other weather-related damage Easy to assemble, easy to maintain and easy to use Perfect centerpiece for your outdoor gatherings or summertime parties

items.label: OUTDOOR BAR TABLE
items.value: Elevate your next gameday party. This portable bar table allows your guests to grab chilled beverages while never being far from any of the action.

items.label: POP UP BAR & HIDDEN COOLER
items.value: Lid elevates upwards 10 inches above the rim for use as a patio bar table. The top reveals a hidden cooler with 7.5-gallon capacity. Keep up to forty 12 oz. cans ice cold.

items.label: VERSATILE USE
items.value: When not being used as a party bar, shut the top and use as a patio coffee table. When elevated, it is the ideal height for use as a hot tub table so you will always have a spot for your drink, snacks, and phone.

items.label: ALL-WEATHER-RESISTANT
items.value: Unlike real rattan and wicker, the thick exterior resin prevents rusting, peeling, and denting in all weather conditions, rain, or shine.

items.label: EASY CLEANUP & LOW MAINTENANCE
items.value: Built in drainage plug makes cleanup a breeze. After the party is over and the ice is melted, simply pull the plug to drain the cooler and let it dry before putting it away until next time.

items.label: GIFTS FOR DAD
items.value: The perfect gift and outdoor bar set accessory for the #1 BBQ Grill Master in your life. It is the ultimate sidekick to his outdoor kitchen.

items.label: BETTER WITH KETER
items.value: We are driven to invent. We create lifestyle solutions for use in and around the home in ways only we can. We design using sustainable and innovative technologies to create products that enhance people’s spaces and elevate their experiences.
